parameters.description:
Send a notification to your own LINE destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

`msg-to-line_msg` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`). On the Apprise channels the gateway composes an Apprise `line://` URL from your stored secrets and delivers via apprise.unitysvc.dev; on the gateway channels it transforms the envelope directly into a LINE Messaging API push-message body and posts it to api.line.me with no Apprise involved.

Four channels are available: the free `apprise` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `apprise-plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters (`token_secret`, `targets_secret`); the free `gateway` channel delivers direct to the LINE Messaging API push message (no Apprise); and the `gateway-plus` channel adds extra per-enrollment LINE destinations, direct, at $0.001 per message.
parameters.gateway_body_template: {"to":"${ customer_secrets.LINE_MSG_TARGETS }","messages":[{"type":"text","text":{* _escape_json((_body.title or "")..(((_body.title or "")~="" and (_body.body or "")~="") and "\n" or "")..(_body.body or "")) *}}]}
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment LINE destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to LINE Messaging API push message (no Apprise)

targets_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's LINE targets

token_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's LINE token
